newsitem.title: UK: British Airways strike talks break down.
newsitem.headline: British Airways strike talks break down.

text.p: Talks aimed at averting a strike by British Airways cabin crew broke down on Sunday, Britain's Press Association news agency reported.
The collapse of negotiations makes it increasingly likely that the cabin crew will go ahead with the first of their planned three day strikes on Wednesday.
BA last week submitted proposals to try to end the five-month-old dispute over pay and conditions to the cabin crew's Transport and General Workers' Union (T&G).
Britain's arbitration service, ACAS, was overseeing the latest round of talks in a hotel in southern England.
The airline is also in dispute with ground staff over its plans to sell its catering unit at London's Heathrow airport.
